title: UP-engine global noise field receipt
description: Evidence object for whether tile noise is a coordinate-consistent global field. Pass surfaces are split: noise_synthetic_ok (CI/synthetic_contract) ≠ noise_live_verified (live_capture). Fail-closed. Never grants execution or edit permission. No GPU in this revision.

field_kind.description: shared_seed_only = RandomNoise seed present without coordinate indexing proof. coordinate_indexed requires global XY→noise mapping with overlap equality.

evidence_grade.description: static_seed_only = observed RandomNoise seed. synthetic_contract = CI synthetic proof. live_capture = host tensor/generator receipt. synthetic ≠ live.

mechanism.description: Which of the three mechanism contracts this receipt claims. global_then_local_refinement is architectural, not a seed tweak.

coordinate_frame.description: Name of the coordinate system used for indexing (e.g. global_canvas_xy, latent_xy).

canvas_sha256.description: Optional SHA-256 of the BASE canvas / coordinate frame binding.

seed.description: Optional RNG seed observed or used; presence alone never proves a global field.

tile_origins.description: Global origins [x, y] for tiles participating in the probe.

global_latent_shape.description: For global_latent_once_crop: declared [H, W, C] of the synthetic/global buffer.

global_stage.description: For global_then_local_refinement: stage-1 global field evidence.

local_refinement_stage.description: For global_then_local_refinement: stage-2 architectural refinement evidence (not reseed).

verified.description: Legacy/umbrella flag. On synthetic_contract it means synthetic overlap only. Live PASS requires noise_live_verified=true separately.

synthetic.description: True when proof used a synthetic deterministic field (not live Comfy noise).

noise_synthetic_ok.description: Synthetic PASS surface. CI may set true. Does NOT imply live PASS.

noise_live_verified.description: Live PASS surface. True ONLY with evidence_grade=live_capture + host tensor/generator proof. CI must not set true in this revision.

host_id.description: Required for live_capture when claiming noise_live_verified.

tensor_or_generator_proof.description: Live proof payload: sha256 of captured noise tensor and/or generator_id.
